content: Released the [**XTile-S2O-Urban76**](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22082922) dataset on Zenodo: full-scene Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 pairs from 76 cities (access restricted during peer review).
content_zh: 在 Zenodo 发布 [**XTile-S2O-Urban76**](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22082922) 数据集：76 个城市的 Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 整景影像对（审稿期间为受限访问）。

content: Visiting student at the University of Pavia, Italy, with **Prof. Paolo Gamba**.
